svg.title: ESP32 transceiver
svg.desc: ESP32 transceiver block diagram: receive chain left to right on top, shared LO in the middle, transmit chain right to left at the bottom; each block annotated with the registers that influence it.
svg.text: Direct conversion (zero IF, inferred), half duplex; MCH2022 badge, receive only in esp_sdr
no register known; gain is one
inferred from BBTOP I and Q)
has no ESP32 transmit path and
Analog I2C: block 0x67 (bbtop) through ROM rom_chip_i2c_readReg()/writeReg(); the RF PLL (0x62) and the LO divider (0x65)
through libphy ram_chip_i2c_readReg()/writeReg(), which reach the hosts the ROM versions do not; all under regi2c_enter_critical().
The PLL status bits are not mapped on the ESP32, so esp_sdr_set_freq() never returns -ERANGE here.
